workload: 250000 set +250000 prod shuffled; plain initial0, Init initial3; values1..9.

distributions.short: Uniform start, length1..1024, clipped at n.
distributions.local: Only the centered coordinate interval of width min(n,1000000).

measurement: Fresh process/tree per run, serialized on CPU4; alternate before/current order each repeat; report medians of5. Timed loops include allocation and checksum, excluding trace generation, construction, reservation, verification and output. No compile/test/other benchmark ran concurrently.
memory: Process peak RSS captured before independent reference verification, including input traces, tree storage and transient vector reallocation. Search also holds its preparation trace and probe trace; 128-bit search additionally holds a separate vector of 500000 128-bit thresholds.

variants.before_endpoint: Snapshot immediately before this round of endpoint removal and alignment tuning; separate leaf/branch pools and compact boundary stack already present.
variants.current: Workspace implementation after this round: ordinary32-byte branch alignment; lazy Branch.hi removal and size-preserving64-byte alignment where applicable.

validation: Fresh O2 warning builds and ASan+UBSan passed the randomized/structural suite, generic owning and non-default-constructible value/action suite, throwing-predicate lifetime tests,128-bit coordinate/aggregate regressions and two-TU utility suite. Leak detection disabled due ptrace environment. First repeat of every candidate and final condition independently verified outside timing; every repeat checksum and logical node count agrees across variants. No compile/test/other benchmark ran concurrently with timed processes.
changes: Keep ordinary branches that naturally occupy32 bytes on32-byte boundaries without increasing their size.
Remove the cached right endpoint from lazy branches; carry interval bounds during descent. Keep leaf lengths so partially inserted boundary fragments are aggregated correctly.
Align lazy branches that naturally occupy64 bytes to64-byte boundaries without increasing their size. Other branch sizes retain their natural alignment.
Use at most two leading-zero-count operations for built-in128-bit lazy coordinates; retain the fallback for other wider coordinate types.
Preserve all APIs, pow, ACL-style mapping(F,S), logical node counts and queries that do not create tree nodes.
tradeoffs: The principal gains are in64-bit lazy aggregates. The3-repeat selection sweep included a small slowdown for the128-bit wide alignment candidate; the final selected implementation is remeasured below.128-bit node sizes do not shrink, so process RSS may be slightly higher after over-aligned allocation. No universal-optimum claim is made and all results are retained. The initial3-repeat candidate sweep and selected5-repeat results are both saved. Bit-rank insertion and shared search-tag versions were rejected because they did not consistently improve the fixed workloads.

candidate_evaluation.measurement: Same pinnedCPU4 and unchanged query generation, rotating variant order, separate process per run. Selection sweep; final selected variants remeasured5 times for both N values.

variants.before: Implementation at start of this round
variants.aligned: Size-preserving branch alignment:32 bytes ordinary,64 bytes lazy
variants.rank: Ordinary insertion compares highest-bit ranks instead of masks
variants.nohi: Lazy branch right endpoint removed; bounds carried during descent
variants.nohi_aligned: Lazy endpoint removal plus size-preserving alignment
variants.tag_versions: Lazy boundary frames reference shared composed actions instead of storing action copies

original_comparison_note: The linked original_comparison report compares the original pointer tree with the workspace before this endpoint/alignment round; its measurements and hashes remain historical.
